dedupe_keys.name: visimarsrutai lt gtfs feeds of lithuanian public transport

description: visimarsrutai.lt publishes a directory of GTFS timetable feeds for Lithuanian public transport, organised by municipality and operator (for example Akmenė, Alytus, Anykščiai, Birštonas, Biržai and Druskininkai). On 2026-09-29 the directory listed, for each feed, a ZIP file with an HTML and a JSON validation report generated the same day, so users can see the quality of each feed. Coverage: municipal and regional services across Lithuania. Format and access: an open web directory without registration. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated on the directory page. Caveats: a bare listing with no documentation, and feed quality differs by municipality as the reports show. It supports network flow models of Lithuanian bus and regional services. It relates to the GTFS specification, and the Riga GTFS Realtime data in the catalogue.
name: visimarsrutai.lt GTFS feeds of Lithuanian public transport

sources.note: directory, municipal feeds, validation reports, dates
